Mom made another business video, which means I had to supervise the voice, the music, the timing, and the general lack of snacks.
She says Bluedobie Developing helps small businesses with websites, content tools, and getting their online presence cleaned up.
I say if the humans are going to stare at screens this much, the screens should at least be useful.

🐾 Sabre, Head of Quality Control

I inspected the closet corner. The closet offered no explanation.
@zeketheoldmanrottie monitored the television. The news anchor had concerns. Zeke shared them.

I circled the bed seven times before settling. The spot was unchanged. The circles were necessary.
Mama went to the bathroom. I did not feel this required commentary.

Zeke filed a look in my direction. I filed one back.
This is how we maintain order around here.

— Sabre

I need to borrow Sabre’s page for a minute.

For almost 11 1/2 years, this blue dog has been beside me.
He’s the reason Bluedobie has its name. The original Blue Dobie. My shadow, my supervisor, my migraine and blood sugar alarm, my personal-space problem, and occasionally the self-appointed head of household operations.
And he is still completely Sabre.

He still follows Mama everywhere. He still knows when it’s Bird 30. Food remains extremely important. He still supervises Daddy, Zeke, and everyone within range.

His body just can’t keep up with him anymore.

His mobility has gotten worse, he’s living with chronic pain, and the things he still wants to do are becoming harder on him than they are enjoyable.

Anthony and I have made the decision to let him go peacefully on September 24, as long as he continues to tell us that’s the right time.

We’re not waiting for an emergency to make the decision for us. And September 24 is not a deadline we’re making him reach. If he tells us sooner that he’s had enough, we’ll listen.

But right now?
He’s here.
And while he’s here, this is still Sabre’s page.

There will still be food reports, nose pictures, ridiculous sleeping positions, Bird 30, Doberman High Council business, and whatever other nonsense Mr. Blue fits into the next few weeks.

I’m not turning his time into a countdown.

A lot of you have followed Sabre for years. You’ve laughed at the food reports, attended entirely too many meetings of the Doberman High Council, admired the nose, witnessed Bird 30, and loved this ridiculous blue dog right along with us.

Thank you for loving my little blue dog. 💙

If you’d like to send Sabre a card, a little gift, or a message for me to read to him, DM me for our mailing address. There's no expectation to send anything, and I will only share our address privately.
Anything he doesn’t get to use will go to Zeke.

I’ll be stepping away from socials on September 23. I don’t know what happens with this page afterward, and I’m not deciding that now.

For now, Mr. Blue still has business to conduct.

And apparently Mama has become much more reasonable about the distribution of people food.
We’ll take it from there

- Mama 🐾💙

Sabre Cam: Episode 1 — The Watch Begins
I thought he’d go explore…
but he had other plans.
(apparently I require constant supervision) 🐾

He barked at me for singing while I was holding his birthday cake.

Every year I try to make this a sweet birthday moment. Every year Sabre reminds me that if I’m holding cake, I should stop the ceremony and start serving.

The foot stomp. The bark. The absolute lack of patience. Happy Birthday to my very opinionated boy. 🖤🐾

Today is Sabre’s 11th birthday 🖤
And if there’s one thing I know about him…

it’s that he loves deeply, quietly, and completely.

Thank you to everyone who showed up for him this month.

You gave him exactly what he asked for.

— Mama

I had it. 🦴 Speed was there.
Focus was there.

Zeke just… participated. 🐾

Follow for elite-level field testing.

#FriYAY

I wasn’t expecting this answer.

Sabre turns 11 on April 29th 🖤
and when I asked what he wanted…

it wasn’t treats or toys.
He said he wants more friends to love.
So we’re going to surprise him.

Drop your pup.
Tell him where you’re from.
I’ll make sure he sees every bit of it 🐾

Let’s give him the biggest circle of friends he’s ever had.
— Mama
